author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages

slides.title: One plan, not *three* versions of the truth
slides.body: Sales and operations planning, step by step

slides.title: What S&OP *really* is
bullets: One agreed plan for demand, supply and money
Runs every month and looks months ahead
Ends with a decision, not a status update

slides.title: Clean data, *honest* demand
bullets: Close last month: actuals, stock, master data
Sales and marketing agree one forecast
Flag promotions, launches and known risks

slides.title: Test it against *supply*
bullets: Supply gap = demand plan minus capacity

slides.title: Options with a *price* tag
bullets: Build ahead, add a shift, or protect top SKUs
Show each in cost, service and inventory
Bring 2 or 3 choices, not one answer

slides.title: Leaders *decide*, then commit
bullets: Pick one option and name the owner
Next month, check: did we do what we said?

slides.title: S&OP is judged by the *decisions* it makes
slides.body: Save this for your next review.
